physics_frozen.pump: on for the ENTIRE run -- rl_pump_stop_time deliberately ABSENT, exactly as the headline matrix. The pump is NOT the variable under test here; the five per-lump exotic dials are.

runs.notes: Canonical twin of the frozen champion: identical configuration with all five per-lump exotic dials pinned to 0. Geometry deliberately matches FMAX-RC (L=128, N=192, t=32) so it differences directly against a measured cell -- RC gave f_geo_evol 0.1568, confinement retention 0.442, spread x3.01, persistence 0.024. The question is whether the dispersal established in Phases 4-5 survives removal of the exotic sector. 1 GPU.

acceptance.notes: Not a convergence cell. Read the difference in confinement_retention, confinement_spread_ratio and structural_persistence against FMAX-RC. If they match, the dispersal is independent of the exotic dials.
